family.description: release family, e.g. llama, qwen, gpt, claude, deepseek, qwen3

active_params_b.description: active/activated params per token; equals params_b for dense

shared_expert.description: always-on shared expert (DeepSeek-style) adds to per-token active params

embedding_dims.description: output embedding dimensionality. The decision-relevant number for an embedding or reranking model: it sets the index size (dims x 4 bytes per vector) and the per-query ANN cost, and for Matryoshka models it is truncatable at query time. Null for autoregressive LMs, which have no fixed output vector.

embedding_pooling.description: pooling that produces the embedding vector. CLS for BERT-style models, mean for models trained with average pooling, last for decoder-only. Getting this wrong silently degrades retrieval quality with no error.

kv_lora_rank.description: MLA latent KV rank: the width of the compressed KV vector actually cached, in place of num_kv_heads * head_dim. DeepSeek-V2/V3 use 512. This is why an MLA model can hold a longer context than a GQA model of similar size, and it is NOT derivable from head_dim. Null for non-MLA models.

qk_rope_head_dim.description: MLA decoupled rotary sub-head width (64 in DeepSeek-V2/V3). Added to kv_lora_rank to give the per-layer per-token KV cache size: num_layers * (kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim) * bytes_per_element. Null for non-MLA models.

qk_nope_head_dim.description: MLA non-positional (NoPE) QK sub-head width (128 in DeepSeek-V2/V3). Affects attention arithmetic and the projection shapes, not the cached KV size. Null for non-MLA models.

v_head_dim.description: MLA value sub-head width. In DeepSeek-V2/V3 this equals qk_nope_head_dim, which is why MLA caches (kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim) and NOT (2 * v_head_dim) bytes per token. Recorded separately because the two are independent in general. Null for non-MLA models.

kv_compression.description: per-layer KV compression, when it is not uniform. V4-style CSA (compressed-sparse attention) gives selected layers a much lower compression ratio than the HCA baseline, so a single average ratio hides the real peak. Describe the ratio per layer group and name the groups. Null when the model has no layered compression or the compression is uniform.

attention_layer_indices.description: zero-based indices of the layers that are full attention, for hybrid architectures. Hybrid KV cost depends entirely on this split: only these layers carry a KV cache. Null for uniform architectures.

layer_types.description: per-layer type in layer order, e.g. ['attention','ssm','attention',...]. Pairs with attention_layer_indices; when present its length should equal num_layers. Null when the architecture is uniform.

context_scaling.description: YaRN, NTK-aware, LongRoPE, mrope, etc; null when native

context_scaling_method.description: queryable classification of the context-extension method. Deliberately NOT an enum on context_scaling: that field has no enum and carries free-text values in 100+ existing records ('verified native', 'mrope', 'llama3 rope scaling'), so an enum there would break all of them at once. Keep the detail in context_scaling and the class here. native = extended to the model's own trained length with no scaling; none-verified = suspected native but not confirmed; unknown = not established. `unknown` means the record's author looked and could not establish the method; null means the field was simply never filled in.

attention_variant.description: standard, MLA (multi-head latent attention), GQA, MQA, sliding-window/hybrid, NSA, lightning attention

kv_cache_bytes_per_token.description: the single most decision-relevant number for serving; derive in notes

flops_per_token_active.description: approx 2 * active_params_b * 1e9; the per-token compute cost

sources.description: source ids; each must exist in data/sources/
